parsed.notes: The core ZSK claim is clearly reproduced: divergence is machine-zero (L2 ~2.5e-15, Linf ~7e-14) across all Re, confirming the collocated fractional-step scheme with momentum interpolation achieves discretely divergence-free velocity fields. Quantitative agreement with Ghia is strong: RMS errors in u and v are 0.7-1.5% for Re=100/1000, with Re=400 showing slightly elevated v_max_err (0.148) due to one apparent outlier at x=0.9063. Peak velocities (u_min, v_min, v_max) match Ghia within 1-3% at all Reynolds numbers. The boundary condition at y=1 shows ~3-6% deviation from u=1, likely due to interpolation to cell centers rather than a fundamental error.
quibbles: Top-wall u values (0.94-0.97 instead of 1.0) suggest the lid BC is evaluated at cell centers rather than the wall face, inflating near-wall errors.
Re=400 v at x=0.9063 shows a large discrepancy (Ghia: -0.2383, ours: -0.3861), likely a transcription error in Ghia table lookup or interpolation issue at that single point.
Boundary v values at x=0,1 are nonzero (up to 0.029), indicating slight slip or interpolation artifacts at walls.
The study uses uniform Cartesian grids rather than the curvilinear grids emphasized in ZSK, though this validates the method's Cartesian limit.
